senses.gloss:
r. 6th cl. (किलति)
1 To be or become white.
2 To play.
r. 10th cl. (केलयति)
To send, to throw or cast.

ind.
An aptote signifying,
1 News, (so said, so reported.)
2 Likelihood, (probably, possibly.)
3 Conciliatory expression.
4 Assertion, certainty, (indeed, verily, assuredly.)
5 Falsehood, inaccuracy.
E.
किल to send or order, affix क.

r. 10th cl. (कीलयति)
To bind, to fasten, to stake, to pin.

mf. (-लः-ला)
1 Flame, lambent flame.
2 Small, minute.
m. (-लः)
1 A stake, a pin, a bolt, a wedge, &c.
9 A lance, a pike.
2 A gnomon.
4 A weapon.
5 A post, a pillar.
6 The elbow.
7 A blow or punch with the elbow.
8 A blow, a thump; (in the three last senses some make this also fem.)
9 A post in a cow-house: see the next.
E.
कील to bind, and क aff.

n. (-तं)
Amorous agitation, weeping, laughing, being angry, being pleased, &c. in the society of a lover.
E.
किल play, sport, किं what, some, and चित collected.

f. (-ला)
Sound expressing joy, or the expression of pleasure by any sound or cry.
E.
किल play, sport, repeated.

mf. (-टः-टी)
Inspissated milk, curds or coagulated milk; it may be applied to cheese.

m. (-टी)
A bamboo.

m. (-सः)
1 A blotch, a scab.
2 A white leprous spot.
E.
किल to play, affix क; आस from आस to reject or throw, with अच् affix; or अस to be, with अण् aff.

m. (-घ्नः)
A sort of gourd, (Momordica mixta): see काकरोल.
E.
किलास a blotch, and घ्न what removes.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Having blotches.
E.
किलास, and इनि aff.

mn. (-ञ्चः-ञ्चं)
A thin plank: see the next.

mn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जं)
1 A thin plank of green wood.
2 A mat: see the next; also read किलिञ्च.

m. (-कः)
A mat.
2 A screen or twist of grass or straw.
E.
किल to be white, इ added किलि, ज what overcomes, from जि with ड affix, and वुन् added; deriv. irr.

m. (-मः)
A tree, a kind of fir or pine, (Pinus deodar.)
n. (-मं)
Resin, the extract of the pine.
E.
किल to cast, किमन् aff.

m. (-ल्वी)
A horse; read also किन्धिन्.

n. (-षं)
1 Sin.
2 Fault, offence.
3 Disease, sickness.
E.
किल to play or sport, टिषच् Uṇādi affix, and वुक inserted.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Wicked, culpable, criminal.
E.
किल्विष, and इनि aff.

m. (-कः)
A pillar for cows, &c. to rub themselves against, or one to which they are tied.
2 A pin, a bolt, a wedge.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-र्शः)
A plant, the fruit of which yields a turpentinous substance that has been used in India as pitch, &c. commonly Gab; (Embryopteris glutinifera, Rox.)
E.
कील a bolt, सम् with, and स्पर्श touch, the fruit being invested with a hard coat.

n. (-लं)
1 Water.
2 Blood.
3 Amṛta, the food of the gods.
4 Honey.
E.
कील flame, and अल what opposes, &c. or कील a stake, &c. and अल what adorns; from अल् with अण् aff.

m. (-धिः)
The ocean.
E.
कीलाल water, and धि what contains.

m. (-पः)
A Rākṣasa, a sort of goblin or imp.
E.
कीलाल blood, and प who drinks.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bound, tied, confined.
2 Pierced, transfixed.
3 Staked, impaled.
4 Pinned, fastened by a stake, &c.
5 Set up as a stake or pole.
E.
कील to bind, affix क्त.
